scope: External author work only; no maintained file, schema, parser, Git, GitHub, or frozen package edits.
runtime: The system Python lacks PyYAML. Parser work uses an already installed project virtual environment with bytecode writes disabled; no dependencies were installed.
acquisition: Own acquisitions are sequential public GET requests with 1.5-second pacing and exact original bodies/headers/times/statuses. Three UniProt records are exact original reuse with predecessor receipt and release metadata.
local_tooling_correction: The first combined manifest verification helper assumed all manifest path fields were absolute and stopped at HANDOFF.md. The helper was corrected to resolve relative paths against each frozen package root; the succeeding complete verification passed. This changed no source original or frozen manifest.
staged_concurrency: The sequence author saved an explicit incomplete checkpoint and paused at the parent request to reserve a publication review slot, then resumed after the gene/taxon author finished. The checkpoint remains history, not the final sequence completion statement.
gitignore_independent_inventory: All package completeness/absence assertions use pathlib.rglob or rg --files --hidden --no-ignore, including hidden and ignored files.
review_role: Source author only. Successful local parser, sequence, hash and inventory checks are not independent scientific/technical approval.
